languages.details: Can't speak any language, Speak with animals, Speak with plants

details.publicNotes:
Some places in the world seem to have their own personalities. An impression of malice surrounding a cave, serenity amidst a glade, or joy radiating from a secluded waterfall becomes a shared experience for all travelers who reach these secluded wonders. When strong magic infiltrates these locations, it can take the form of a land spirit or a genius locus. Such spirits often have the ability to reshape their domains, confounding invaders or easing the path for welcome guests. While nymphs tend not to reside within a genius loci's domain, nymphs and genius loci respect each other as caretakers of the land.

Most genius loci arise naturally at the confluence of ley lines. Druid circles can also manifest a genius loci using an obscure ritual, but the ritual's complexity and cost mean that even the few who know the steps are unlikely to perform it.

Fighting the Land

Genius loci typically try to preserve their lands as they are, resisting encroaching farmers, loggers, and others who would radically change the area's nature. Such behavior often leads to violent conflict between a genius loci and would-be settlers. Killing a genius loci rarely results in the land being changed for the better; where a genius loci has died, wells dry up, mines collapse, and crops develop strange blights.

Suggested Monster Parts

items.name: Safe Passage (At Will, Within Domain Only)

description.value:
Area 10-foot-wide, 10-foot-tall, 60-foot-long section of terrain

You make passage through the area safe for a brief amount of time. Anyone passing through the area gains the following benefits against harmful effects of the terrain and environment, including environmental damage, hazardous terrain, and hazards in the area. The spell grants a +2 status bonus to AC and saves against such effects, and resistance 5 to all damage from such effects. Furthermore, the spell prevents anything in the area that's prone to collapse, such as a rickety bridge or an unstable ceiling, from collapsing, except under extreme strain that would collapse a normal structure of its type.

Safe passage protects only against harm, not inconvenience, and it doesn't reduce difficult terrain, remove the @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.DmAIPqOBomZ7H95W]{Concealed} condition caused by precipitation, or the like, nor does it protect against creatures within the spell's area.

@UUID[Compendium.pf2e-anachronism.spell-effects.Item.5blVLpIH65hvFJpn]{Spell Effect: Safe Passage}

Heightened (5th) The granted resistance increases to 10, and the area can be 120 feet long.

Heightened (8th) The granted resistance increases to 15, and the area can be 500 feet long.

You conjure a large boulder in the air and send it crashing down to the ground. The boulder appears at the top of the cylinder before falling. Creatures underneath the boulder take 4d12 bludgeoning damage and must attempt a Reflex save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected.

Success The creature takes half damage.

Failure The creature takes full damage. If it was flying, it is repositioned to the bottom of the cylinder, landing on its feet without taking additional falling damage.

Critical Failure The creature takes full damage. If it was flying, it is repositioned to the bottom of the cylinder, landing on its feet without taking additional falling damage. If it is on the ground after the boulder's fall, it is knocked @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.j91X7x0XSomq8d60]{Prone}. If it's still in the air, it's instead @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.AJh5ex99aV6VTggg]{Off-Guard} for 1 round or until it spends an action to right itself, whichever comes first.

Heightened (+1) The damage increases by 1d12 and the cylinder's maximum height increases by 10 feet.

You can ask questions of and receive answers from plants and fungi, but the spell doesn't make them more friendly or intelligent than normal. Most normal plants and fungi have a distinctive view of the world around them, so they don't recognize details about creatures or know anything about the world beyond their immediate vicinity. Cunning plant or fungus monsters are likely to be terse and evasive, while less intelligent ones often make inane comments.

Heightened (4th) The duration is 8 hours.

You can ask questions of, receive answers from, and use the Diplomacy skill with animals. The spell doesn't make them more friendly than normal. Cunning animals are likely to be terse and evasive, while less intelligent ones often make inane comments.

items.name: Plant Growth (Doesn't Require a Secondary Caster)

description.value:
Area 1/2-mile-radius circle centered on you

You cause the plants within the area to be healthier and more fruitful. In addition to other benefits of healthy plants, this increases the crop yield for farms, depending on your success. If you cast it in the area of a @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.7yWXx3qC4eFNHhxD]{Blight}, plant growth attempts to counteract the blight instead of producing its usual effect.

Critical Success Double the crop yield in the area, or increase the area to a 1-mile radius.

Success Increase the crop yield in the area by one-third.

Failure The ritual has no effect.

Critical Failure The flora in the area changes in an unanticipated way, determined by the GM but generally as contradictory to your true desires as possible (for instance, blighting crops when you would prefer to enrich them).

A genius loci is mystically bonded to a sacred site, such as a secluded grove or pristine pond. The land within 1 mile of this site is the genius loci's domain. The appearance of the land within the domain subtly alters to reflect the genius loci's physical and emotional state. Likewise, damage to the land manifests on the genius loci. If the domain suffers from large-scale pollution or magical blight, the genius loci is @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.4D2KBtexWXa6oUMR]{Drained 1} until the land is restored. If the genius loci exits their domain, they become @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 1} and can't reduce the condition's value by any means until they return to their domain. They must succeed at a @Check[fortitude|dc:26] save every day they spend separated from their land or increase the sickened value by 1 (to a maximum of @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.conditions.Item.fesd1n5eVhpCSS18]{Sickened 4}).

Trigger A creature within 60 feet Strides

Effect The land itself attempts to lead creatures astray. The triggering creature must attempt a @Check[will|dc:28] save.

Critical Success The creature is unaffected and is temporarily immune to Shifting Paths 1 hour.

Success The creature's Speed is reduced by 5 feet for this Stride.

Failure The creature's Speed is reduced by 15 feet for this Stride.

Critical Failure The creature Strides its full speed in a direction of the Genius Loci's choice. This is forced movement.

Requirements The genius loci is within their domain

Effect The genius loci reshapes the terrain in a @Template[burst|distance:30]{30-foot radius} around them, making it easier or harder for other creatures to traverse. They can change normal terrain into difficult terrain, difficult terrain into normal terrain or greater difficult terrain, and greater difficult terrain into difficult terrain. Regardless of what they choose, they can freely move through altered terrain as through it were normal terrain. The altered terrain persists for 1 minute or until the genius loci uses this ability again, whichever comes first.

Frequency Once per day

Effect The genius loci casts 5th-rank @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.R5FHRv7VqyRnxg2t], @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.kOa055FIrO9Smnya], or @UUID[Compendium.sf2e.spells.Item.KsWhliKfUs3IpW3c]; each genius loci has access to whichever of these spells most closely fits with the nature of their domain.
